mission.statement: Two independent agents can reconcile and extend the backend and frontend MVP against one frozen browser contract without cross-lane task dependencies or overlapping file ownership.
mission.terminal_signal: Exactly two agent queues exist; each lane passes its own checks, no task depends on the other lane, and the integration owner runs the combined gate after merging.

goals.title: Backend agent queue
goals.rationale: One backend owner can reconcile typed models, merge decisions, upstream I/O, and routes without waiting for frontend changes.
goals.completion_signal: Backend tests, Ruff, and ty pass in the backend worktree.

goals.title: Frontend agent queue
goals.rationale: One frontend owner can reconcile Zod contracts, the relative API client, and the editor screen against the frozen API without backend task dependencies.
goals.completion_signal: TypeScript and Vite build pass in the frontend worktree.

tasks.title: Reconcile backend project contracts
tasks.rationale: Validated browser inputs and narrow response projections must match the frozen API before backend behavior is adjusted.
tasks.acceptance_test: uv run --project backend ty check backend/project_editor/contracts.py

tasks.title: Verify three-way merge and conflict cases
tasks.rationale: The pure merge boundary must preserve different-field edits and flag overlapping edits before routes use it.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `merge.py` exports `merge_edit(base: EditableFields, proposed: EditableFields, current: EditableFields) -> MergeResult`.

tasks.title: Verify upstream replacement and uncertain writes
tasks.rationale: The adapter must preserve latest linked companies and distinguish missing reads, unavailable reads, and ambiguous PUT results.
tasks.sdd_snippet: It signals missing projects, unavailable reads, and uncertain writes distinctly.

tasks.title: Verify list, show, and save routes
tasks.rationale: Routes combine validation, merge results, upstream I/O, and the agreed 200/409/504 responses.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `main.py` alone maps those outcomes to the browser HTTP responses. No worker adds a fourth endpoint.

tasks.title: Reconcile frontend Zod contract
tasks.rationale: The frontend needs typed request and response validation while preserving the exact base snapshot for merge comparisons.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `contracts.ts` exports Zod schemas and inferred `ProjectSummary`, `ProjectDetail`, `EditableFields`, and `EditableField` types.

tasks.title: Verify relative browser API client
tasks.rationale: All browser requests and error parsing must use the same /api boundary.

tasks.title: Verify editor screen and local proxy
tasks.rationale: The frontend agent owns list, show, edit, conflict resolution, uncertainty UI, and local routing in one lane.
tasks.sdd_snippet: `App.tsx` owns selection, the list and edit form, base/draft snapshots, key-date rows, per-field conflict choices
